title: The returns agent
starter: Show me the returns agent working
intro: Here is the returns agent working on a made-up order. One agent checks the request against the policy and scores it. The other drafts the reply and waits for a person. Pick a request to watch it run.
disclaimer: A working re-creation with made-up orders. Nothing is sent.

agents.name: Checker
agents.role: Finds the order and scores the request against the policy. It never replies to customers.

agents.name: Writer
agents.role: Drafts the reply and waits for a person to approve it.

paths.label: 70 to 100: refund offered, and a person approves the exact reply.
paths.research: Order, delivery date and photos checked.

paths.label: 40 to 69: store credit offered, and a person approves the reply.
Below 40: a short reply asking for more detail, sent without approval.

gates.label: No earlier reply to this request

handoff: Checker saves its findings on the order and notifies {sender}.

approval.covers: the exact recipient, subject and body
